system.description: You move as a bolt of lightning almost instantaneously to a location you're familiar with on the same planet. The location must be outdoors or open to the sky. Effort: Travel to an indoor location if a lightning bolt could find an open route to that spot from the outside (such as through a window or doorway). Action.
